content.title: Luka Doncic injury update: Experts weigh in on grade 2 hamstring tear recovery timeline; Lakers worried | Hindustan Times
content.text: The Los Angeles Lakers' playoff hopes took a hit on Friday after it was revealed that Luka Doncic will miss the remainder of the regular season with a left hamstring strain.Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic (77) celebrates a three point shot during the first quarter against the Indiana Pacers (IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect)Doncic "has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and will be out for the remainder of the regular season," the Lakers, who have five games left in the regular season, said in a statement. ESPN reported that Doncic, who leads the league in scoring, is "uncertain" for the playoffs.Read More: Luka Doncic injury news: What is Extraordinary Circumstances Challenge? Lakers star's only hope for MVPWhat a Grade 2 hamstring tear meansA Grade 2 hamstring injury is classified as a partial muscle tear, more severe than a mild strain but not a complete rupture. Sports medicine experts indicate that such injuries typically require 4 to 8 weeks for a full return to competitive play.This type of injury is particularly tricky for athletes, as premature return significantly increases the risk of re-injury, something teams are usually cautious to avoid, especially before the playoffs.Recovery timeline explained by expertsAccording to medical experts writing for Cleveland Clinic, xphysio.com.au and Total Orthopedic Care, here is how rehabilitation could look:Acute Phase (Days 1–5): Focus on rest and inflammation control using RICE (rest, ice, compression, elevation)Subacute Phase (Weeks 1–3): Gradual introduction of pain-free movement and light strengtheningStrengthening Phase (Weeks 3–6): Progressive resistance training and functional recoveryRead More: Luka Doncic injury update: Lakers star's MVP chances still alive; agent issues postseason updateReturn-to-Sport Phase (Weeks 6–8+): Controlled return to running, sprinting, and game-specific movementsWhy the Lakers are concernedFor the Lakers, the timing is far from ideal. Doncic has been central to their offense, and his absence heading into the playoffs could significantly alter their championship chances. Even if he returns within the lower end of the recovery window, he may not be at full strength.Key risks and expert adviceExperts caution that hamstring injuries carry a high re-injury risk, particularly if players resume activity too early. Key recommendations include:Avoid aggressive stretching in the early stagesFocus on rebuilding strength in surrounding muscle groups like the glutes and coreEnsure full, pain-free range of motion before returning
